title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brandon Cisse (rib) not expected to miss significant time
items.desc: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said Brandon Cisse is not expected to miss significant time with rib injury.
items.impact: It is unclear if IR is being considered. Either way, the rookie will miss some time.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Johnathan Edwards signs with Colts active roster
items.desc: The Colts have signed CB Johnathan Edwards to the 53-man roster.
items.impact: Edwards had been on the Colts practice squad. He will add depth in their secondary.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) uncertain on practicing this week
items.desc: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said Jacory Croskey-Merritt is uncertain on practicing this week.
items.impact: Croskey-Merritt is eligible to have his practice window opened this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Skyy Moore (ankle) avoids serious injury
items.desc: Packers WR/KR Skyy Moore's ankle injury from Sunday is not considered serious.
items.impact: Moore just returned from injured reserve due to an ankle injury. Green Bay will be cautious with him.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Indianapolis Colts D/ST recover fumble for TD in win
items.desc: The Indianapolis Colts D/ST recovered a fumble for a touchdown, as well as racking up three sacks in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
items.impact: The Colts' defense helped out the team's struggling offense with a fumble recovery in the endzone, which was then offset later in the game by a pick-six by the Dolphins' defense. They will face off against the Texans on Thursday.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Spencer Shrader goes for six kicking points in win
items.desc: Spencer Shrader hit all three of his PATs and his only field goal attempt in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
items.impact: Shrader was perfect in this game, and now has 17 kicking points in his last two games after going quiet for a three-game stretch. He is likely going to be a bit up and down given the Colts offense, or lack thereof.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Anthony Gould snags two passes in win
items.desc: Anthony Gould caught two of four targets for 28 yards in the Colts' 24-22 win over Miami.
items.impact: Gould had the second most receiving yards on the team, but with only two catches to his name and no touchdown, it amounted to little for fantasy. He's best left on waivers with the Colts passing game currently stagnant.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Ashton Dulin snags deep reception in win
items.desc: Ashton Dulin caught one of two targets for 30 yards in the Colts' 24-22 win over Miami on Sunday.
items.impact: Dulin had a nice grab in the win, but did little else on offense. He's not worth a pickup off of waivers as of now.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Laquon Treadwell snags touchdown in win
items.desc: Laquon Treadwell caught all three of his targets for 24 yards and a score in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
items.impact: Treadwell was limited to short area gains in this contest, but made it count with a touchdown. While there could be some potential value in Treadwell, it's hard to make any sort of move for him or any other Colts pass catcher when QB Daniel Jones is playing so poorly.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Seth McGowan punches in score in win over Dolphins
items.desc: Seth McGowan ran for 77 yards and a touchdown on 12 carries in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
items.impact: McGowan wasn't involved in the passing game, but when you can run for 6.4 yards a pop and find the end zone, that makes up for a lot. He is becoming more involved in the offense in recent weeks and could be finding his way into flex territory. Granted, touchdowns have greatly helped his fantasy production, without them he would be much less appealing.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Tyler Warren quiet in win over the Dolphins
items.desc: Tyler Warren caught two of three targets for one yard and ran once for three yards in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins.
items.impact: Warren found some new lows in a season of low points. Earlier in the season, he was helped out by touchdowns, but he last scored in Week 2. He's had some decent yardage games, but also some low totals. QB Daniel Jones is largely to blame here, though Warren himself isn't doing as much on his touches as he did last year.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Daniel Jones has putrid performance in win over Dolphins
items.desc: Daniel Jones completed 11 of 22 passes for 108 yards, a touchdown, and two picks in the Colts' 24-22 win over Miami.
items.impact: Jones continued his trend of putrid play. There's no sugar coating it. The Colts won because the Dolphins were starting their backup QB, not because of anything Jones did. Had it been anyone else, we'd be talking about a loss. You have to wonder how much longer the coaching staff can continue trotting out Jones, who has been hampering this offense all season.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Jonathan Taylor goes for 103 yards in win over Miami
items.desc: Jonathan Taylor ran 16 times for 83 yards and caught two of four targets for 20 yards in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins.
items.impact: Taylor led the offense in touches but it was Seth McGowan scoring the touchdown on Sunday. Taylor should still have decent volume most weeks, but his upside is going to be limited as long as the Colts QB play is this poor.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Miami Dolphins D/ST has pick-six in loss
items.desc: The Miami Dolphins D/ST managed two interceptions, including a pick-six, and a sack in the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts on Sunday.
items.impact: The defense did what they could to keep the Dolphins in this game, but it wasn't enough. They kept Daniel Jones to 108 passing yards and a putrid 2.2 QBR, but the Miami offense with QB Kyle McCord just couldn't get going against the Colts either. It's a tough loss, and they have to face Buffalo next week.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Jalen Tolbert nabs long touchdown in loss to Colts
items.desc: Jalen Tolbert caught both of his targets for 49 yards and a touchdown in the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts on Sunday.
items.impact: Tolbert was the beneficiary of a trick play drawn up by the Dolphins, where he broke free for a touchdown pass delivered by Malik Washington. He's starting to get a little more involved in the offense, but he's still not worth picking up, given the context of the situation in Miami.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Greg Dulcich shut out in loss
items.desc: Greg Dulcich failed to catch either of his targets in the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts on Sunday.
items.impact: Dulcich has had some promising performances this year, but far too often he's putting up duds. He is best left on waivers.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Malik Washington throws bomb touchdown in loss
items.desc: Malik Washington caught all three of his targets for 50 yards and also threw a 34-yard touchdown in the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts.
items.impact: Washington surprised in this game, throwing a beautiful deep touchdown pass to Jalen Tolbert on a trick play. He finished second on the team in receptions and second in receiving yards on the day, and could be a PPR-flex option next week against the Bills.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Caleb Douglas racks up 71 yards in loss
items.desc: Caleb Douglas caught three of eight targets for 71 yards in the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts on Sunday.
items.impact: Douglas's 71 yards are a welcome sight, especially on just three catches. It's unfortunate his day could have been much bigger given the eight targets. Next week he gets a tougher challenge against Buffalo.
